sense: support and further (the arts, health, a cause)

evidence: Plin. Ep. 8.12.1: studiōsōs amat fovet prōvehit
terms.comment: Literally to keep warm, as a bird its eggs or a mother her child, and so to cherish and support (Lewis & Short): studia fovēre, to promote learning.
To feed, rear, and so to make something grow (Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: Colit studia, studiōsōs amat fovet prōvehit
phrases.english: He cultivates learning, and loves, supports and promotes those who pursue it

phrases.latin: honōs alit artēs, omnēsque incenduntur ad studia glōriā
phrases.english: honour feeds the arts, and everyone is fired to study by the hope of glory

sources: Lewis & Short: foveo · Lewis & Short: alo
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 365 (promote: the arts).
